headline: War 140 Enters 193rd Day as Strongpoints Trade Hands Across Front
war_summary: War 140 is in its 193rd day with no winner declared, and the evening returns bring no end to the bargaining over strongpoints. The Weathered Expanse leads the list with fifty-six strategic-base events in the last day, and its casualty rate is still climbing on both sides; the Stlican Shelf follows with forty events, including exchanges logged in the last two hours. Linn Mercy, Godcrofts, Stonecradle, and Callahan's Passage all show active base-change records, and the first three remain divided between Colonial and Warden ownership. At the last two-hour mark, Stonecradle and Stlican Shelf are among the liveliest, while Callahan's Passage continues to draw high losses. Elsewhere, several one-color hexes show only enlistment and light casualty trends, with no strategic-base movements to report. No side has taken the thirty-four victory towns required to ring down the curtain. If the next twenty-four hours repeat the recent pattern, the decisive movements should come from these half-dozen fronts.
